title: It Was Fine Five Minutes Ago

pre.en: Why did the website go down?
options: Too many people arrived from one shared link.

intro: 团队群聊：Rota 上线前一晚 10 点 47，网站突然挂了。Hannah 急得乱点，Chen 查日志，远在班加罗尔的 Arjun 被警报叫醒，一起找原因。读的时候留意 without doing 和 instead of doing：「没做……就……」「不……而是……」，后面的动词都要加 -ing。

sentences.en: Is anyone awake?
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: It's 10:47, the website's gone down out of the blue, and we go live in ten hours!
sentences.zh: 现在晚上 10 点 47，网站突然挂了，我们十个小时以后就要上线了！

sentences.en: I'm here.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Let go of the mouse, Hannah.
Every refresh makes it worse.
sentences.zh: 你每刷新一次，它就更糟一点。

sentences.en: Sorry!
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: Is it hackers?
Did one of us fall for a fake email?
sentences.zh: 是不是我们谁上了假邮件的当？

sentences.en: I opened a strange one about a parcel this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上就点开过一封怪怪的，说什么包裹。

sentences.en: Instead of guessing, let's look at the logs.
sentences.zh: 别瞎猜了，我们看看日志。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I'm checking them now.
My phone woke me at 4:17 with a server alarm, so I got up to check.
sentences.zh: 凌晨 4 点 17，手机上的服务器警报把我吵醒了，我就起来看看。
sentences.speaker: Arjun

sentences.en: My dad was a night-shift engineer, and now I'm following in his footsteps.
sentences.zh: 我爸以前是上夜班的工程师，现在我也算接了他的班。

sentences.en: Everyone, settle down.
It's probably something simple.
Arjun, can you talk me through the server settings?
sentences.zh: Arjun，你能一步步带我改一下服务器设置吗？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: You can do it without turning on your camera.
Good, because you don't want to see my hair right now.
sentences.zh: 那太好了，我现在这头发你可不想看。
sentences.speaker: Arjun

sentences.en: Open the second tab and read me the top line.
sentences.zh: 打开第二个标签页，把第一行念给我听。

sentences.en: Done.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: The numbers don't add up, though.
Two thousand visitors in three minutes, all from one link.
sentences.zh: 三分钟来了两千个访客，全是从同一个链接进来的。

sentences.en: That's not an attack.
sentences.speaker: Arjun

sentences.en: That's people.
Somebody's shared that link.
sentences.zh: 有人把那个链接传出去了。

sentences.en: Oh no.
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: I have to own up to something.
I sent the link to my mum this afternoon without telling her it was a secret.
sentences.zh: 今天下午我把链接发给我妈了，没跟她说这是保密的。

sentences.en: OK, don't panic.
sentences.speaker: Arjun

sentences.en: We can fix it by adding a second server, instead of turning the whole site off.
sentences.zh: 我们加一台服务器就能解决，不用把整个网站关掉。

sentences.en: Whatever you two decide, I'll go along with it.
sentences.zh: 你们俩怎么定，我都照办。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: It's 11:58, and the site's back up.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: We can all breathe a sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 大家都可以松一口气了。

sentences.en: Thank you both.
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: This launch means the world to me.
sentences.zh: 这次上线对我太重要了。

sentences.en: Let's call it a night instead of staring at graphs.
sentences.zh: 今天就到这儿吧，别再盯着那些图表了。

sentences.en: Fingers crossed for tomorrow.
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Mum's just replied.
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: "Sorry, love. I only shared it with my gardening forum.
sentences.zh: 「对不起啊，宝贝。我就发到了我们的园艺论坛上。

sentences.en: There are only 3,000 of us."

cards.note: suddenly and when nobody expects it
cards.tip: 放在句尾最常见；blue 指晴朗的天空，晴天里打雷，意想不到。
cards.example: An old friend called me out of the blue last week.

cards.note: to stop holding something or someone
cards.tip: 后面有宾语时用 let go of sth；没有宾语只说 let go。这里是玩笑：别再死按着刷新了。
cards.example: Don't let go of the rope until I tell you.

cards.note: 这里当名词用，指刷新一次；动词是 refresh the page。
动词 hack into sth（黑进……）。

cards.zh: 上（某种花招）的当；信以为真
cards.note: to be tricked into believing something that is not true
开发里常用复数 logs；log in 是「登录」。
闹钟是 alarm clock；set an alarm 定闹钟。
to do the same job or the same things as someone, often a parent, did before you
cards.tip: sb's 跟着人称变：in my father's footsteps / in his footsteps；footsteps 一定用复数。
cards.example: She followed in her mother's footsteps and became a doctor.

cards.note: to start living a quiet life in one place, often with a partner, a home and a steady job
cards.tip: 第 74 课学的是「安家、安定下来」；这里是另一个常见意思：大家冷静、安静下来。
cards.example: The children took twenty minutes to settle down after the party.

cards.zh: 一步步给某人讲解、带着某人做
cards.note: to explain to someone how to do something, one step at a time, while they do it
cards.tip: sb 放在 talk 和 through 中间；也可以只讲不做：talk sb through the plan（把计划给某人讲一遍）。
cards.example: The nurse talked me through what would happen during the operation.

cards.note: if numbers or facts do not add up, they do not make sense or seem wrong

cards.zh: 承认（自己做错的事）；坦白
cards.note: to admit that you have done something wrong
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 doing：own up to eating the cake；没有宾语时只说 own up：Come on, own up!
cards.example: Nobody owned up to breaking the printer.

cards.note: to accept something or agree with someone, often without saying what you really think
to feel happy and relaxed because something bad did not happen or has ended
cards.tip: breathe 是动词，读 /briːð/；breath 是名词，读 /breθ/，别拼混。
cards.example: When the plane landed safely, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

cards.note: What a relief!（总算放心了！）形容词 relieved。

cards.zh: 对某人来说无比重要；是某人的宝贝
cards.note: to be extremely important to someone, usually because of feelings or memories
to stop what you are doing for the rest of the evening
cards.tip: 常用 Let's call it a night；白天收工说 call it a day。
cards.example: It's nearly midnight. Shall we call it a night?

cards.note: ph 读 /f/，读作 /ɡrɑːf/。
something you say when you hope that something will happen in the way you want
cards.tip: 来自把中指叠在食指上祈求好运的手势；完整说法是 keep your fingers crossed。
cards.example: My interview is at ten. Fingers crossed!

cards.note: 读 /ˈfɔːrəm/；在论坛发帖是 post on a forum。
